method: Primary official Google pages opened using web tool in this audit session; summaries are interpretations, not full quotes.

sources.verified_summary: Domain/subdomain identity is distinct from a page title. Selection is automated. A WebSite preference belongs in the existing entity. Root redirects are addressed when the target is accessible.

Updated 27 October 2026: square image at least 8×8; recommend larger than 48×48. Current listed formats: BMP, GIF, ICO, PNG, JPEG, PPM and TIFF. Display is not guaranteed. Homepage redirects and icon crawling must work.

Automated shortcuts selected using link structure and usefulness. Concise titles, headings, anchors and logical structure help; there is no direct ordering setting. A noindex removal affects the whole page.
Automatically drawn mainly from page content; may use the description and vary by query. data-nosnippet excludes selected content from snippets without excluding the entire page.
Automatically derived from title, headings, prominent text and references. Google may omit a repetitive site name. Titles should agree with the primary content language.

HTML, header and sitemap hreflang methods are equivalent; redundant implementations offer no additional benefit. Google detects content language algorithmically, rather than using hreflang or the HTML lang attribute for detection.
A crawl-visible noindex rule removes the whole page from Google Search. Blocking crawling can prevent Google from seeing the rule.
